content.title: DISCONNECT FOLLOWING WIRES AND CABLES:
items: (a) Ground strap from the cylinder head
(c) High-tension cord from the ignition coil

content.description: Illustration showing disconnection of hoses from engine components

content.title: DISCONNECT FOLLOWING HOSES:
items: (b) Actuator vacuum hose (with cruise control system)
(c) Fuel hose from the intake manifold

content.description: Illustration showing radiator upper hose disconnection from thermostat housing

content.text: DISCONNECT RADIATOR UPPER HOSE FROM THERMOSTAT HOUSING

content.description: Illustration showing removal of air intake connector with clamp bolts

content.title: REMOVE AIR INTAKE CONNECTOR
items: (a) Disconnect the No. 1 air hose from the air intake connector.
(c) Loosen the throttle body hose clamp and remove the air intake connector and the connector pipe.

content.description: Illustration showing disconnection of various hoses from cylinder head and throttle body area

content.title: DISCONNECT FOLLOWING HOSES:
items: (a) No. 1 water by-pass hose from ISC valve.
(b) No. 2 water by-pass hose from throttle body.
(c) Two PCV hoses from the cylinder head cover.
(d) Fuel hose from the fuel hose support.
(e) Label and disconnect the emission control hoses from the throttle body and air intake chamber to allow removal of the cylinder head.
